The Position
Parnagian Architects is seeking a talented and experienced Project Architect or Senior Architectural Designer with approximately 7–10 years of professional experience.
This is a hands-on role for an architect or designer who combines strong design judgment with excellent technical and organizational abilities. The successful candidate should be comfortable working independently, managing multiple project responsibilities, and advancing work with limited day-to-day direction while remaining highly collaborative.
The position will involve projects at multiple stages of development, from programming and conceptual design through construction documentation and construction administration. Because of the size of the practice, the role is broader than a conventional production position and offers meaningful responsibility, direct client and consultant interaction, and the opportunity to influence the evolution of the firm.
As a small practice, we offer an unusually broad level of project involvement. Team members participate meaningfully in design, visualization, documentation, consultant coordination, client communication, and construction administration. This position provides an opportunity to work directly with the firm principal and take a significant role in the continued development of a growing design practice.
Responsibilities
Work directly with the firm principal to develop and execute the architectural vision for each project
Advance projects through predesign, schematic design, design development, construction documentation, permitting, bidding, and construction administration
Develop thoughtful and well-resolved architectural details consistent with the overall design intent
Produce clear, accurate, coordinated, and constructible drawing sets using Revit
Coordinate structural, civil, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, landscape, and other project consultants
Assist with zoning, building-code, accessibility, and regulatory research
Communicate directly and professionally with clients, consultants, contractors, vendors, and reviewing agencies
Participate in client presentations and project meetings
Review shop drawings, submittals, RFIs, and contractor questions during construction
Conduct site visits and document construction progress
Manage project priorities, schedules, deliverables, and overlapping deadlines
Contribute to the continued development of office standards, BIM workflows, project-management systems, and quality-control procedures
Support the growth of the practice while maintaining a consistently high standard of design and documentation
Qualifications
Professional degree in architecture from an accredited program
Approximately 7–10 years of relevant professional experience
Significant experience with custom residential, hospitality, or similarly detailed design work
Strong design portfolio demonstrating work from conceptual design through built execution
Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Revit
Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite
Experience with Vray, Enscape, or comparable visualization software
Experience producing and coordinating complete construction-document sets
Experience with specification writing
Strong knowledge of architectural detailing, building assemblies, materials, and construction methods
Working knowledge of applicable building codes, zoning regulations, and permitting processes
Experience coordinating engineering and specialty consultants
Construction administration and field experience
Strong graphic, written, and verbal communication skills
Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and proactively move projects forward
Ability to organize and prioritize work across multiple active projects
Professional licensure is preferred but not required
The Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate is a thoughtful, motivated, and technically capable architect or designer who is passionate about architecture and values design quality at every scale. This person should enjoy the range and responsibility of working in a small studio and be equally comfortable developing a design concept, resolving a construction detail, coordinating with consultants, communicating with a client, or addressing an issue in the field.
We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, communicates clearly, anticipates project needs, and understands that strong architecture depends on both compelling ideas and disciplined execution.
This is an opportunity for an experienced professional to become an important part of a growing practice, assume meaningful project responsibility, and help shape the firm’s next phase.
Position Details
Location: Red Bank, New Jersey
Position: Full-time or Part-time with potential to grow into full-time
Work arrangement: In-office / Hybrid
Compensation: Commensurate with experience, licensure, and qualifications
To Apply
Please submit the following to [email protected]:
Resume
Portfolio or selected professional work samples
Brief letter describing your experience and interest in joining Parnagian Architects
Professional references
